steps.title: Deliver the six mandatory LZA v1.16.1 config files under inputs/lza-phase0/config/
steps.intent: Deliver, under inputs/lza-phase0/config/ (the only folder this workload permits — issue #109 requires all work product inside inputs/lza-phase0/ and forbids editing any other repo folder), exactly the six mandatory LZA desired-state files (accounts, global, iam, network, organization, security) and nothing else there — no customizations-config.yaml. Every key name must be one the pinned Landing Zone Accelerator v1.16.1 release (tag v1.16.1, commit 8b43dc6e347b5fc1c477940c7f71ea595fbf19ab) actually accepts, verified against the checked-out release source under vendor/lza rather than from memory. The files carry the Phase 0 credential-free posture: homeRegion/enabledRegions and controlTower.landingZone.version stay consistent with lza.lock; the iam and network extension collections are empty; the central security services (macie, guardduty, securityHub, detective, auditManager) and AWS Config recorder/delivery/aggregation are disabled so LZA provisions nothing. NOTE: the six files already present at inputs/lza-phase0/config/ already validate against v1.16.1 (every key accepted, no required key missing) and already meet this posture, so absent a concrete value change from the operator (see q-intended-change) this delivery is a validated confirmation, not a rewrite.
steps.acceptance: inputs/lza-phase0/config/ contains exactly the six mandatory files and no customizations-config.yaml; all six parse as YAML and are accepted by the pinned LZA v1.16.1 config validator; the iam/network extension collections are empty; the central security services and AWS Config recorder/delivery/aggregation are disabled; and global-config homeRegion, enabledRegions and controlTower.landingZone.version agree with inputs/lza-phase0/lza.lock.
steps.stand_in: Deliver at inputs/lza-phase0/config/ (per the workload's 'work only inside inputs/lza-phase0/' rule) the six files that already validate against pinned LZA v1.16.1, with account emails kept as the existing example.com literals (a valid EmailAddress form, safe for the credential-free tracer). Pending q-delivery-location, q-intended-change and q-account-emails.

verification_targets.check: inputs/lza-phase0/config/ holds exactly the six mandatory LZA files (accounts/global/iam/network/organization/security-config.yaml) and no customizations-config.yaml.
verification_targets.run: bash -c 'set -e; d=inputs/lza-phase0/config; test -d "$d"; test "$(find "$d" -maxdepth 1 -type f | wc -l)" -eq 6; for n in accounts global iam network organization security; do test -f "$d/$n-config.yaml"; done; test ! -e "$d/customizations-config.yaml"'

verification_targets.check: All six config files under inputs/lza-phase0/config/ parse as YAML.
verification_targets.run: python3 -c 'import yaml,glob; ps=sorted(glob.glob("inputs/lza-phase0/config/*.yaml")); assert len(ps)==6, ps; [yaml.safe_load(open(p)) for p in ps]'

verification_targets.check: Phase 0 credential-free posture: iam/network extension collections are empty and the central security services (macie, guardduty, securityHub, detective, auditManager) and AWS Config recorder/delivery/aggregation are disabled.
verification_targets.run: python3 -c 'import yaml; d="inputs/lza-phase0/config"; L=lambda n: yaml.safe_load(open(f"{d}/{n}-config.yaml")); iam=L("iam"); net=L("network"); sec=L("security"); assert all(iam[k]==[] for k in ("providers","policySets","roleSets","groupSets","userSets")); assert all(net[k]==[] for k in ("transitGateways","vpcs","vpcTemplates","vpcPeering")); assert sec["awsConfig"]["enableConfigurationRecorder"] is False and sec["awsConfig"]["enableDeliveryChannel"] is False and sec["awsConfig"]["aggregation"]["enable"] is False; assert all(sec["centralSecurityServices"][s]["enable"] is False for s in ("macie","guardduty","securityHub","detective","auditManager"))'

verification_targets.check: global-config homeRegion, enabledRegions and controlTower.landingZone.version agree with inputs/lza-phase0/lza.lock (no drifting literal).
accounts-config declares exactly the three mandatory accounts Management (OU Root), LogArchive (OU Security) and Audit (OU Security), with workloadAccounts empty (LZACFG-010..013).
verification_targets.run: python3 -c 'import yaml; a=yaml.safe_load(open("inputs/lza-phase0/config/accounts-config.yaml")); m={x["name"]:x["organizationalUnit"] for x in a["mandatoryAccounts"]}; assert m=={"Management":"Root","LogArchive":"Security","Audit":"Security"}, m; assert a["workloadAccounts"]==[]'

verification_targets.check: organization-config enables the organization and declares exactly the Security and Infrastructure OUs (LZACFG-020..021).
verification_targets.run: python3 -c 'import yaml; o=yaml.safe_load(open("inputs/lza-phase0/config/organization-config.yaml")); assert o["enable"] is True; assert [u["name"] for u in o["organizationalUnits"]]==["Security","Infrastructure"]'

boundary_cases.description: config/ under inputs/lza-phase0/ must hold exactly the six mandatory files — no seventh file and specifically no customizations-config.yaml (REP-001). A build that adds an extra file, or omits one of the six, fails the delivery even if the files present are individually valid.

Phase 0 is the credential-free tracer: the delivered config must leave the iam/network extension collections empty and every central security service and the AWS Config recorder/delivery/aggregation disabled, so LZA would provision nothing. Enabling any of them here is a regression against REQ-049/REQ-051 and LZACFG-050/060/070..074.

The six files already present at inputs/lza-phase0/config/ already validate against the pinned LZA v1.16.1 source (every key accepted, no required key missing) and already meet the Phase 0 posture. The delivery must NOT regress this. If the operator confirms no value change is intended (q-intended-change), the delivery is a validated confirmation and the verification targets above will already hold against the current tree — the operator should expect that rather than a net file change.

A near-identical copy of these six files already lives at the repository-root config/ (delivered by the lza-phase0-0 tracer; the only diff today is useV2Stacks present in inputs/ but absent at root). This workload writes only inputs/lza-phase0/config/ and must not touch root config/. Which of the two copies is authoritative for Phase 0 validation is a decision for the operator (q-delivery-location).
